the gate is reaching a second line, because SUCCESSOR-2 enrolled patients with a median of two prior lines of therapy (Bristol Myers Squibb release, 29 May 2026). Fonseca R et al., 'Frontline treatment patterns and attrition rates by subsequent lines of therapy in patients with newly diagnosed multiple myeloma', BMC Cancer 2020;20:1087 (doi 10.1186/s12885-020-07503-y, PMC7656738), Table 4, three US databases 2000 to 2018: of 22,062 patients treated without a transplant 43% received a second line, and of 2,763 with a transplant 79% did. (22,062 x 0.43 + 2,763 x 0.79) / 24,825 = 47.0%, about 16,900 of the 36,000 a year

column11: a judgement. The relapsed myeloma line is the most crowded in haematology: pomalidomide, isatuximab, elotuzumab, selinexor, three BCMA T-cell engagers and two CAR-Ts sit in or beside it. What mezigdomide has is an oral regimen with an 18.0-month median progression-free survival in a triple-class-exposed population, against 8.3 for the carfilzomib backbone, and Bristol's own myeloma sales force. A fifth of second-line-and-later patients is a real but not dominant share
